findings.requirement: Every receipt must be proven to exist at or before the frozen population manifest commit; post-freeze receipt creation must fail closed.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/population_git_trust.py:100-101 accepts a receipt when `git merge-base --is-ancestor freeze origin` succeeds. This accepts an origin commit descending from the freeze commit, including receipts created after the population was frozen. The R005 repair contract explicitly requires post-freeze receipt creation to fail closed.
findings.falsifier: Create the manifest in commit F, create a valid receipt in descendant commit R, and run load_exact_receipts with QUEUE_REF at R. The current implementation accepts the receipt instead of emitting a provenance error.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Require the receipt origin commit to be an ancestor of the manifest freeze commit, or verify the receipt path exists in the freeze commit tree; add a regression test for a newly created post-freeze receipt and an independently modified post-freeze receipt.
